annual.note: 10-K for fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2025 (amounts filed in thousands, converted to millions). Debt = three fixed-rate senior notes (principal 2,500; carrying 2,480.15), all non-current (2027 Notes mature Sept 10, 2027); 1.25bn revolver undrawn. Short-term investments = marketable equity 83.244 + AFS debt securities 70.970 held inside Prepaid expenses and other (AFS debt maturities are mostly beyond one year). Unvested restricted stock 4.646m mixes unissued RSUs and restricted stock awards; the reported share count may already include restricted stock awards, so overlap with sharesOutstanding is possible. Pending at the date: Hexagon design and engineering acquisition (about EUR 1.89bn cash + about EUR 810m in new CDNS shares) announced Sept 4, 2025 and closed Feb 23, 2026; not on the Dec 31, 2025 balance sheet. Euro forward contracts liability 26.0 at Dec 31, 2025 not included.

ttm.note: 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2026 (filed 2026-07-29) is the latest filed quarterly report by 2026-10-21 (Q3 10-Q not yet filed). TTM = FY2025 + H1 2026 - H1 2025; H1 2025 operating income includes a 128.5m export-control contingent-liability loss, which depresses the subtracted base and lifts TTM operating income. Hexagon design and engineering acquisition closed Feb 23, 2026 (cash about 2.2bn paid, 3.224m shares issued, value 902.2m; cash acquired 154.6); revenue only includes it from that date, so TTM flows are not pro forma while the June 30 balance sheet is post-acquisition. Debt = 2.5bn senior notes (carrying 2,482.2); the 1.25bn revolver is undrawn after 600m repaid in H1 2026. Options and unvested restricted stock are carried from the 10-K as the 10-Q omits them. Deferred tax liabilities rose to 349.9 (acquired intangibles); 10-Q does not itemise acquisition tax claims.

notes: Cadence files 10-K and 10-Q. Statements are in thousands of USD; converted to millions.
Annual base FY2025 (Dec 31, 2025; 10-K filed 2026-02-19). TTM base through Jun 30, 2026 (10-Q filed 2026-07-29).
carriedFrom used for TTM unvestedRSUs, options (10-K, Dec 31, 2025) and the current portion of operating lease liabilities.
Hexagon D&E acquisition closed Feb 23, 2026: the TTM flows contain about four months of it while the Jun 30 balance sheet includes full goodwill/intangibles, cash used and shares issued.
